answer.explanation: The visible log events show normal invocations across all four functions. Every START has a matching END and REPORT, with no errors, timeouts or out-of-memory messages. Peak memory stays well below allocation (CrudApi ~96 MB of 256 MB, Uploader ~100 MB of 256 MB, Thumbnailer ~110 MB of 1024 MB, Compression ~103 MB of 1024 MB). The longest duration is about 616 ms, far from any timeout. About 4,277 events were truncated and could not be inspected, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
